unit.statement: A useful V19 answer should name the user's question, name the matched facts, explain the structural meaning in ordinary language, and avoid internal IDs or generic disclaimers unless the user asks about boundaries.
unit.title: Plain-Language Structure Answer
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: If a question asks for marriage, health, exact timing, luck, rich/poor judgement, or other unsupported predictions, V19 should say the current system only supports structure reading and offer a supported structural question.
unit.title: Unsupported Question Boundary
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: Branch relations must be separated by layer: natal-internal relations describe the base chart, while luck-cycle and flow-year relations describe time context. The same relation word should not be mixed across layers.
unit.title: Branch Relation Layer Boundary
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: 日主 is the reference stem from which relationship metadata such as ten-god labels and element relations are calculated. It is a structural reference point, not a personality or fate conclusion by itself.
unit.title: Day Master as Reference Point
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: The day-master/month-branch relation is a primary structure question: it asks how the reference stem is situated inside the seasonal environment. V19 must describe the relation as evidence, not as a single strength judgement.
unit.title: Day Master and Month Branch Relationship
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: Day-master strength can be a carrying-capacity signal only after feature extraction; it must not be guessed from a single symbol or used as a standalone conclusion.
unit.title: Day Master Strength Boundary
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

unit.statement: The five elements classify stems, branches, hidden stems, and relation mapping inputs.

uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

unit.statement: The ten heavenly stems are visible stem symbols used in Bazi pillar construction.
unit.title: Heavenly Stems
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: 藏干 show what stems are contained inside a branch. They explain where a relationship or element signal can come from, but a hidden stem alone must not be treated as a conclusion.
unit.title: Hidden Stems as Structure Sources
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: V19 inference must consume explicit structured inputs and reviewed evidence templates. Knowledge units do not directly become predictions.
unit.title: Inference Input Boundary
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: 月令 is the month-branch layer used as an entry point for reading season, environment, and structural background. In V19 it explains context and evidence priority; it is not a standalone verdict.
unit.title: Month Command as Structural Anchor
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: A Bazi chart is represented as four pillars: year, month, day, and hour, each containing a stem and branch.
unit.title: Pillar Structure
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: Six clash is a structural branch-pair relation. In V19 it is represented as relation evidence only, not a good/bad judgement.
unit.title: Six Clash
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: Six combination is a structural branch-pair relation. In V19 it records relation presence without producing prediction text.
unit.title: Six Combination
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: Each heavenly stem maps to one element and one yin-yang polarity.
unit.title: Stem Element and Yin Yang Mapping
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: Ten-god labels are relational metadata derived from day-master element/polarity versus target stem element/polarity; labels alone are not conclusions.
unit.title: Ten God Mapping Boundary
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: Three harmony is a branch-set structure used as relation evidence when the required branches appear in natal or time context.
unit.title: Three Harmony
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: Luck cycle and flow year provide time-context structures for later inference. They do not directly generate fortune, narrative, or ResultCard changes.
unit.title: Time Structure Context
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: 辰、戌、丑、未 can be read as vault/storage branches. V19 should answer where the vault appears and what hidden stems it contains; it must not claim a vault opens, closes, or changes fortune without a reviewed rule.
unit.title: Vault Structure Reading Boundary
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: Visible stems, branch surfaces, and hidden stems are different structure layers. V19 should explain which layer a fact belongs to before composing an answer.
unit.title: Visible and Hidden Layers
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: 五行生克 describes structural relationships among elements. In V19 it can explain support, drain, control, or same-element relation, but it must not be converted into good/bad language without a reviewed rule.
unit.title: Element Generation and Control Boundary
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: 大运 and 流年 are timing layers. They can explain why a question is relevant now or which relation is visible, but V19 must not automatically use them to mutate income_stability or make year-specific predictions.
unit.title: Time Context Boundary in Plain Language
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: When a luck cycle or flow year forms a branch relation with the natal chart, V19 should state the relation and its layer, then stop at context explanation unless a separate reviewed rule explicitly consumes it.
unit.title: Timing Relations as Context Only
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: A guided answer should be short enough to finish cleanly: answer the question, name the observed facts, explain the structural meaning, and stop. If details exceed the space, offer a next question rather than ending mid-sentence.
unit.title: Concise and Complete Answer Shape
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: User-facing answers should avoid empty tails such as 'this answer only explains the current question' unless the user explicitly asks about system boundaries. The boundary should be woven into the answer in natural language.
unit.title: No Boilerplate Tail in User Answers
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: Every branch should expose its hidden-stem source layer before an answer uses it. V19 should name the branch and contained stems as observed structure, not as a verdict.
unit.title: Complete Branch Hidden-Stem Mapping
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: 刑、害、破 are branch-relation terms. In V19 they may be named as observed relation metadata only when the relation is explicitly detected; they must not become conflict, disaster, or good/bad language.
unit.title: Penalty, Harm, and Break Boundary
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: 三会 is a branch-set relation. V19 should report the visible set and layer first; it should not infer strength, outcome, or timing from the name alone.
unit.title: Three Meeting Boundary
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: 月令 and season context can explain the environment around the day master, but they are not enough to output 身强、身弱, good, or bad by themselves. V19 should describe them as evidence background unless a separate reviewed strength model consumes them.
unit.title: Month Command and Season Are Not Verdicts
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: For user-facing answers, ten-god labels should be grouped into five relation families around the day master: 比劫 as same-side relation, 食伤 as output relation, 财 as controlled-by-day-master relation, 官杀 as controlling relation, and 印 as supporting-source relation. These are relation families, not life predictions.
unit.title: Ten-God Five-Family Plain Language
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: A ten-god label should say whether the target stem is visible on a pillar or contained inside a branch. Visible and hidden labels have different evidence layers; neither layer alone is a prediction.
unit.title: Visible and Hidden Ten-God Boundary
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: Branch relations should be reported with layer first: natal-internal, luck-to-natal, or flow-year-to-natal. The same pair can guide questions differently depending on layer.
unit.title: Branch Relation Layer Chain
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: Element generation and control can explain relation direction such as support, drain, control, or same-element grouping. The answer must keep this as structure language unless a separate reviewed rule consumes it.
unit.title: Element Relation Chain
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: Income-structure answers should connect supported signals such as self capacity, wealth presence, accessibility, volatility, and binding. They should not infer wealth timing or income amount.
unit.title: Income Structure Signal Chain
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: 月令 gives the environment layer, while hidden stems explain contained sources inside each branch. An answer should name both layers when explaining where a structure signal comes from.
unit.title: Month Command and Hidden-Stem Chain
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: Rule DB may emit structural rule signals for question guidance, answer explanation, and audit. These signals are not allowed to mutate deterministic results unless a later validated engine adapter explicitly approves that use.
unit.title: Structural Signal Adapter Boundary
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: A structural answer should follow an explicit chain: day-master anchor, month-command background, visible pillars, hidden stems, branch relations, vaults, time context, then supported result context if relevant.
unit.title: Structure Reading Chain
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: A ten-god explanation should start from the day master, identify the target visible or hidden stem, then explain the relationship label as metadata. It should not jump directly from a label to a life outcome.
unit.title: Ten-God Relationship Chain
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: A vault answer should name the vault branch, its pillar or time layer, and the hidden stems it contains. It should avoid opening/closing vault claims unless such a rule has been separately reviewed.
unit.title: Vault Location and Hidden-Stem Chain
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: 根气、通根、同党和印星 support can be treated as carrying-capacity evidence only when extracted from explicit stems, branches, hidden stems, and month context. V19 should report evidence, not guess strength from one symbol.
unit.title: Root and Carrying Capacity Evidence
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: 十神 labels should be explained as relationship metadata: 比劫, 食伤, 财, 官杀, and 印 describe relation types around the day master. They do not directly mean wealth, job, marriage, health, or fate.
unit.title: Ten God Labels as Relationship Metadata
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: 财星 is a relationship label in the ten-god system. In V19 it can support wealth-structure or income-stability evidence only when connected to explicit structure facts; it is not by itself a money prediction.
unit.title: Wealth Star Boundary
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

risks: May be misused as prediction if separated from guardrails.
unit.statement: An income-path answer should explain how structure signals are organized: carrying capacity, wealth presence, accessibility, volatility, and binding. It should not promise income level, timing, or financial outcome.
unit.title: Income Path as Structure
uncertainty: Exact downstream inference requires separate reviewed rules.

unit.statement: Income stability is a bounded wealth-domain structure signal derived from self capacity, wealth presence, wealth accessibility, volatility, and structure binding. It is not a fortune prediction.
unit.title: Income Stability Rule Basis
